IServiceCollectionExtensions may contain only IServiceCollection extension methods.

What the Standard says

The Standard keeps each architectural element focused, explicit and discoverable at its owned boundary. read it here.

Why it matters

Enforcing this rule gives callers and maintainers one predictable contract and makes drift visible during the build. The analyser proves this specific source-level condition; it does not replace runtime acceptance or security testing.

Bad code example

// Violates STXAPP010
public static string GetName() => "Students";

Good code example

// Follows STXAPP010
public static IServiceCollection AddStudents(this IServiceCollection services) => services;
